morphology.pattern_note: 在本条采用的漫威角色语境中，Thanos 是整词专名，没有马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为英语读法；不将 th 分析为马来语构词成分。

senses.zh_definition: 灭霸：漫威漫画及其改编作品中的虚构角色，亦称“疯狂泰坦”，以追求无限宝石及其力量而闻名。
senses.en_definition: A fictional Marvel character, also called the Mad Titan, known for seeking the Infinity Stones and their power.
senses.ms_definition: Nama watak fiksyen Marvel yang dikenali sebagai Mad Titan dan berusaha mendapatkan Batu Infiniti serta kuasanya.
senses.nuances: 按此批词的电影语境解释为漫威角色；脱离上下文时，Thanos 也可能是现实人物的名字。漫画与电影的设定有所不同，不宜混为一谈。参见 [Marvel：Thanos](https://www.marvel.com/characters/Thanos)。此释义为专名说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pembentangan ini membandingkan gambaran watak Thanos dalam komik dengan penggambarannya dalam filem.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本次汇报比较漫画与电影对灭霸这一角色的塑造。
dual_scenarios.en: This presentation compares the portrayal of Thanos in comics with his portrayal in films.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok adegan Thanos petik jari tu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah menonton adegan Thanos memetik jari itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看过灭霸打响指的那一幕了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you seen the scene where Thanos snaps his fingers?

etymology.historical_story: Marvel identifies Iron Man issue 55 as Thanos's first appearance. The character belongs to an established fictional universe, so Malay discussion generally retains the original name rather than translating it into a descriptive noun. His pursuit of the Infinity Stones provides a memorable cultural association. No Malay root or affix should be invented to explain the name. See [Marvel's character reading guide](https://www.marvel.com/comics/discover/227/thanos-the-mad-titan?EML=080318_Pulse_Character&cid=Pulse).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 Thanos，就联想“灭霸举起手套、准备打响指”的画面；用角色形象记专名。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友间讨论剧情前可先确认对方是否看过；对方说 Jangan cerita dulu 时，应避免继续透露情节。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于影视评论、漫画讨论和影迷聊天。用 Thanos 比喻现实人物属于戏谑，应确保对方接受这种玩笑，避免在正式评价中造成冒犯。
